review: 702.16n-1: the variant cast Gods Willing (white) on Grizzly Bears, which already had protection from white from Pledge of Loyalty, so the cast was illegal; the second protection now comes from equipping the colorless Sword of Light and Shadow, with a fourth Plains for the equip cost.
702.16k-1: noted that True-Name Nemesis now chooses any player (Forge ChoosePlayer with Choices$ Player), which makes the protection-from-B variants of 702.16k-1/2/3 reachable; no outcome change.

scenarios.title: A creature with protection cannot be the target of spells with the stated quality
decisions: A attempts to cast Swords to Plowshares targeting Black Knight, tapping Plains.

variants.label: white_spell
variants.expected: Black Knight (protection from white) is not a legal target for Swords to Plowshares (white); the cast is illegal.

variants.label: red_spell
variants.delta: A attempts to cast Lightning Bolt targeting Black Knight, tapping Mountain, instead.
variants.expected: Black Knight is a legal target for Lightning Bolt (red); the cast is legal.

scenarios.title: A creature with protection cannot be the target of abilities from sources with the stated quality
decisions: A attempts to activate Master Decoy's tap ability targeting Black Knight, paying W with Plains.

variants.label: white_source
variants.expected: Black Knight (protection from white) is not a legal target for Master Decoy's ability (white source); the activation is illegal.

variants.label: blue_source
variants.delta: A attempts to activate Prodigal Sorcerer's ability targeting Black Knight instead.
variants.expected: Black Knight is a legal target for Prodigal Sorcerer's ability (blue source); the activation is legal.

scenarios.title: An Aura of the stated quality is put into the graveyard when its enchanted permanent gains protection

setup.notes: Pacifism is controlled by A and is attached to B's Grizzly Bears.

decisions: B casts Gods Willing targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains, and chooses white.
Both players pass; Gods Willing resolves, then B scries 1 and keeps Forest on top.

variants.label: choose_white
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gains protection from white until end of turn. Pacifism (white) is put into A's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: choose_red
variants.delta: B chooses red instead of white.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gains protection from red until end of turn. Pacifism stays attached to Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.title: Equipment of the stated quality becomes unattached from a protected creature but stays on the battlefield
decisions: A casts Apostle's Blessing targeting Grizzly Bears, paying {1}{W/P} by tapping both Plains, and chooses artifacts.
Both players pass; Apostle's Blessing resolves.

variants.label: protection_from_artifacts
variants.expected: Bonesplitter (an artifact) becomes unattached from Grizzly Bears and stays on the battlefield. Grizzly Bears is 2/2.

variants.label: protection_from_green
variants.delta: A chooses green instead of artifacts.
variants.expected: Bonesplitter stays attached to Grizzly Bears. Grizzly Bears is 4/2.

scenarios.title: Damage from a source with the stated quality is prevented for a protected creature
decisions: A casts Pyroclasm, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Pyroclasm resolves. B does not sacrifice Burrenton Forge-Tender.

variants.label: protected_creature
variants.expected: The 2 damage Pyroclasm (red) would deal to Burrenton Forge-Tender (protection from red) is prevented. It has no damage marked and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: unprotected_creature
variants.delta: B's creature is Savannah Lions (white 2/1) instead of Burrenton Forge-Tender.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions is dealt 2 damage and is destroyed.

scenarios.title: Combat damage from a source with the stated quality to a protected blocker is prevented
decisions: A attacks player B with Hill Giant.
B blocks Hill Giant with Burrenton Forge-Tender, without sacrificing it.
Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: red_attacker
variants.expected: Hill Giant's 3 damage to Burrenton Forge-Tender (protection from red) is prevented; it has no damage and survives. Burrenton Forge-Tender deals 1 damage to Hill Giant, which survives.

variants.label: green_attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Burrenton Forge-Tender, which is destroyed. Burrenton Forge-Tender deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears, which survives.

scenarios.title: An attacking creature with protection cannot be blocked by creatures with the stated quality
decisions: A attacks player B with Black Knight.
B declares Savannah Lions as a blocker of Black Knight.

variants.label: white_blocker
variants.expected: Declaring Savannah Lions (white) as a blocker of Black Knight (protection from white) is illegal.

variants.label: green_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Grizzly Bears (green) as the blocker instead of Savannah Lions.
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Black Knight is legal.

scenarios.title: All damage dealt to a creature with protection from everything is prevented
decisions: A casts Pyroclasm, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Pyroclasm resolves.

variants.label: progenitus
variants.expected: The 2 damage to Progenitus is prevented; it has no damage marked.

variants.label: hill_giant

variants.expected: Hill Giant is dealt 2 damage and has 2 damage marked; it stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A creature with protection from a player cannot be targeted by that player's spells

setup.notes: B chose player A as True-Name Nemesis entered the battlefield.

decisions: A attempts to cast Lightning Bolt targeting True-Name Nemesis, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: protected_from_A
variants.expected: True-Name Nemesis (protection from player A) is not a legal target for A's Lightning Bolt; the cast is illegal.

variants.label: protected_from_B
variants.delta: True-Name Nemesis has protection from player B instead.
variants.expected: True-Name Nemesis is a legal target for A's Lightning Bolt; the cast is legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: The chosen player is a setup fact; B chose A in the base. Current Oracle and Forge let True-Name Nemesis's controller choose any player, so the protected_from_B variant is reachable.

scenarios.title: An Aura that grants protection and says it does not remove itself stays attached, but another instance of the same protection removes it

setup.notes: Sword of Light and Shadow is on the battlefield unattached.

decisions: A casts Pledge of Loyalty targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Plains. Both players pass; Pledge of Loyalty resolves and attaches.

variants.label: pledge_only
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has protection from white and from green through Pledge of Loyalty. Pledge of Loyalty (white) stays attached.

variants.label: second_protection
variants.delta: After Pledge of Loyalty resolves, A activates Sword of Light and Shadow's equip ability targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the other two Plains; it resolves.
variants.expected: Sword of Light and Shadow becomes attached to Grizzly Bears (4/4, protection from white and from black). Pledge of Loyalty is put into A's graveyard in the state-based check.

scenarios.forge_notes: Pledge of Loyalty gives protection from the colors of permanents its controller controls; with Pledge (white), Grizzly Bears (green) and the colorless Sword and Plains that is white and green.

scenarios.title: Benevolent Blessing's protection does not remove Auras its controller already attached

setup.notes: Pacifism is controlled by B and attached to A's Grizzly Bears.

decisions: A casts Benevolent Blessing targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Plains, and chooses white as it enters.
Both players pass; Benevolent Blessing resolves.

variants.label: choose_white
variants.expected: Holy Strength (A's white Aura) and Benevolent Blessing stay attached to Grizzly Bears (3/4). Pacifism (B's white Aura) is put into B's graveyard.

variants.label: choose_green
variants.delta: A chooses green instead of white.
variants.expected: Holy Strength, Benevolent Blessing and Pacifism all stay attached to Grizzly Bears.
